HNZ Referral Criteria Guidelines for lower GI investigations for symptomatic patients

action.title: Guidance
action.description:
Following the introduction of faecal immune-chemical testing (FIT) for symptomatic patients, direct access for CT Colonography (CTC) is being removed as a first line investigation.

Primary care referrals for all lower GI investigations including CTC and Colonoscopy will be via a single point of referral and triage as outlined in the guidance. Most patients will have a FIT test.  Where appropriate, CTC will be requested and appropriate actions taken by the secondary care team. In particular, the secondary care team will be responsible for any follow-up actions based on the results (which includes, but is not limited to, any findings of cancer, polyps or incidental findings).

Please follow the Colorectal Symptoms HealthPathway for local guidance and follow local processes .
